title: Conditional Flow Models Convert Epistemic Uncertainty into Apparent Aleatoric Variance
abstract: arXiv:2610.29172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conditional Flow Models (CFMs) are increasingly being used in place of deterministic predictors across machine learning, including for tasks that were classically formulated as regression. Given their success in such tasks, we ask the question: what useful information do the conditional distributions produced by CFMs carry beyond what a point predictor would provide?   We identify a systematic phenomenon: in many natural regimes, CFM samples routinely have larger variance than the true conditional distribution, even in nearly deterministic regression problems. This effect is most pronounced where the model has not resolved the dependence on the conditioning variable, and thus the additional variance can be viewed as converting epistemic uncertainty in fitting the ground truth conditional distribution into apparent aleatoric variance in the generated samples. translated_title: 条件流模型将认知不确定性转化为表观的偶然方差
translated_abstract: 条件流模型（CFMs）在机器学习的各个领域正被越来越多地用来替代确定性预测器，包括那些传统上被表述为回归的任务。鉴于它们在此类任务中的成功，我们提出了一个问题：CFM生成的条件分布在点预测器所能提供的信息之外，还携带了哪些有用的信息？我们识别出一个系统性现象：在许多自然的情形下，即使在近乎确定性的回归问题中，CFM样本的方差通常也大于真实条件分布的方差。这一效应在模型尚未充分解析出对条件变量的依赖关系之处最为显著，因此这种额外的方差可以被视为将拟合真实条件分布时的认知不确定性转化为生成样本中表观的偶然方差。通过受控的合成数据和真实数据实验，以及与指数族基线的比较……
tldr: 该论文发现条件流模型生成的样本方差会系统性地大于真实条件分布的方差，这种额外的方差本质上是模型将拟合真实条件分布时的认知不确定性转化为生成样本中表观的偶然方差。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that Conditional Flow Models systematically produce samples with larger variance than the true conditional distribution, effectively converting epistemic uncertainty in fitting the ground truth conditional distribution into apparent aleatoric variance in the generated samples.
